node.statement: Theorem 1.2 (Efficient pure state tomography): Given n = O((d + log(1/delta))/epsilon) copies of |psi> in C^d, algorithm A_GKKT outputs |v> with |<v|psi>|^2 >= 1-epsilon w.p. >= 1-delta, using unentangled measurements in poly(n) time. Proof: Set q = epsilon/2 in Lemma 4.2. With n = C(d + log(1/delta))/epsilon^2 * epsilon = C(d + log(1/delta))/epsilon, the failure probability is <= delta. Since ||rho_hat_avg - |psi><psi|||_infty <= epsilon/2, the top eigenvector |v> of rho_hat_avg satisfies |<v|psi>|^2 >= 1 - 2*||rho_hat_avg - |psi><psi|||_infty >= 1-epsilon (by Mirsky/Weyl perturbation [HJ13]) and F(|psi><psi|, |v><v|) = |<v|psi>|^2 >= 1-epsilon. Gate count: poly(n) from the t-design circuits and classical postprocessing.
